full_judgment: 7. Per contra, Mr Md Khurshedul Alam, the learned Deputy Attorney General, submits that the Government is at liberty to transfer its employees and officers at any time and the latter are duty bound to comply with the Government's order without raising any question. He argues that the presumption of the orders, actions and decisions of the Government functionaries is that the same are taken in public interest and, thus, bonafide. He professes that in order to rebut the aforesaid presumption an aggrieved person must make out a clear case of malafide with reference to categorical allegation against specific person/s. By reading out the statements made in the writ petition, he submits that nowhere within the four-corners of the petition, any specific allegation of personal grudge or revenge has been made against any of the respondents.
